properties.name: A finding says when the state it reports is a normal stage rather than a defect
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word. On a design three days old with nothing built, one finding fires once per capability — 17 times on flo2's own graph — each phrased as something to answer, with no hint that having built nothing yet is where the project IS. Its neighbours carry a paragraph that routes to who can answer and says whether the thing is even a defect; this one carries a single line. A person reads seventeen of them as seventeen defects.
